mechanism: FILL_ACCOUNTING_SPEC section 1.5 worst-fill grading: a stop-market exit on a gap bar that trades THROUGH the stop level fills at the WORST of the fill bar's open and close on the quoted side (sell: min(bid_open, bid_close)) minus the U3 slip band - NEVER at the stop price; the distance beyond the ordinary quoted-side-open+band fill is booked as GAP EXCESS inside the slippage-beyond-halfspread line; the spread-once law and the section-6 invariant still close exactly; the row flags LOSS_FILL candidacy.

hand_calc: LEG-X6 long 10,000 EURUSD with a hard stop at 1.08560. ENTRY Thu 2024-06-27 14:00 (ordinary path): fill = ask_open 1.08704 + 0.00002 = 1.08706; mid_open 1.08702; spread_once = 10,000 x 0.00002 = $0.20; slip = $0.20; commission = 0.35 x 1.08706 = $0.380471; cash = 100,000 - 10,870.60 - 0.380471 = $89,129.019529; equity @ entry-bar mid_close 1.08712 = $100,000.219529. HOLD to 18:00 (no 22:00 UTC boundary crossed -> no swap). STOP EXIT on the [18:00,18:01) NEWS GAP bar: the bar OPENS at bid 1.08550 - ALREADY through the stop 1.08560 - and closes further down at 1.08500/1.08504. Worst-fill grading (spec 1.5): the sell executes at worst(bid_open 1.08550, bid_close 1.08500) = 1.08500, minus U3 band 0.00002 -> GRADED FILL 1.08498 - NEVER at the stop price 1.08560. Mark at the gap open (mid 1.08552) before the exit: equity = 89,129.019529 + 10,855.20 = $99,984.219529. EXIT COSTS: mid_at_fill stays the fill bar's OPEN mid 1.08552 (spec 1.4); spread_once = 10,000 x (1.08552 - 1.08550) = $0.20; the ordinary modeled sell would be 1.08550 - 0.00002 = 1.08548, so the graded fill is 0.00050 (5.0 pips) beyond it: GAP EXCESS = 10,000 x 0.00050 = $5.00 booked inside the slippage-beyond-halfspread line (band $0.20 + excess $5.00 = $5.20); cross_cost = |1.08498 - 1.08552| x 10,000 = $5.40 = 0.20 + 5.20 (spread-once law intact); commission = 0.35 x 1.08498 = $0.379743; cash = 89,129.019529 + 10,849.80 - 0.379743 = $99,978.439786; units 0. The row flags LOSS_FILL candidacy (fill beyond modeled band). GROSS VS MID = 10,000 x (1.08552 - 1.08702) = -$15.00 (mid-to-mid; the intra-bar gap move sits in the crossing lines). Cross-check of the full price move: 10,000 x (1.08702 - 1.08498) = $20.40 = 15.00 (mid-to-mid) + 5.40 (graded crossing). NET = -15.00 - 0.40 (spread-once) - 5.40 (slip incl. gap excess) - 0.760214 (commission) - 0 (swap) = -$21.560214 = equity_T - equity_0. EXACT.
